ai-for-non-techies.title: AI for Non-Techies: live workshop

ai-for-non-techies.priceNote: ₹3,999 · includes three months of Biscuit access
ai-for-non-techies.desc: A small four-hour workshop where non-technical professionals bring a real work problem and turn it into a simple AI-powered tool without writing code. Capped at 15 people and run mostly in Hinglish.

ai-leadership-playbook.title: The AI Leadership Playbook
ai-leadership-playbook.venue: Paytm campus, Marol (exact address after registration)
ai-leadership-playbook.priceNote: No ticket price shown · curated, host approval needed
ai-leadership-playbook.desc: A curated morning session for product leaders and operators on leading teams through AI adoption, hosted at Paytm.

aicd-mumbai.priceNote: Free · the listing shows some ticket types as sold out, so check availability
aicd-mumbai.desc: A free full-day community conference on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure and AI, with keynotes and workshops.

build-and-fly.title: Build & Fly: hands-on drone workshop
build-and-fly.venue: Drona Aviation, Punjani Industrial Estate, Thane West
build-and-fly.desc: Build a small drone, learn how it flies, then take part in a flying challenge. For beginners aged 10 and up.

buildup-over-coffee.title: Buildup over Coffee

climate-panchayat.title: Climate Panchayat: solutions for marginalised Mumbaikars
climate-panchayat.venue: Rasā – The Stage, Studio A, Sangam Society
climate-panchayat.desc: A working dialogue where people from vulnerable Mumbai communities describe the climate problems they face, and the audience works with them on practical responses. Part of Climate Week India.

code-to-capital.title: Code to Capital Summit
code-to-capital.venue: 70-C Nehru Road, near Mumbai airport T1
code-to-capital.desc: A LegalTech gathering for founders, IP professionals, corporate leaders and lawyers.

devcon-8.title: Devcon 8 India
devcon-8.priceNote: Indian students $25 by application · India residents $149 · general $499
devcon-8.desc: The Ethereum Foundation's global developer conference, held in Mumbai this year across four days. It is open to engineers, designers, researchers, educators and artists, not only developers.

devday-exchange-mumbai.title: DevDay Exchange Community: Mumbai
devday-exchange-mumbai.desc: A local gathering around OpenAI's DevDay announcements, to share projects, swap ideas and find collaborators. Selected attendees are offered Codex credits.

earthshot-prize-mumbai.title: The Earthshot Prize 2026 Summit and Awards
earthshot-prize-mumbai.venue: Venue not stated on the official page
earthshot-prize-mumbai.priceNote: Access not stated; leaders, investors and philanthropists are invited

elasticon-mumbai.title: Elastic{ON} Mumbai
elasticon-mumbai.desc: Elastic's one-day community conference for developers, SREs and security analysts, with technical tracks, hands-on breakouts and demos on search, observability and agentic AI.

enterprise-ai-summit.title: Enterprise AI Summit Mumbai 2026

global-startups-club-oct10.title: Global Startups Club: Startup Networking Mumbai
global-startups-club-oct10.desc: A networking morning for founders and aspiring entrepreneurs with business speed dating and 30-second pitches.

global-startups-club-oct24.title: Global Startups Club | Startup Networking Mumbai
global-startups-club-oct24.desc: A morning networking meetup for founders and aspiring entrepreneurs with speed-networking rounds and short elevator pitches.

growsphere-mcp-security.title: GrowSphere | Prompt Injection & MCP Security

growsphere-mcp-security.desc: A half-day community session on prompt-injection risks and securing tools built on the Model Context Protocol.

hack-nation-bombay-hub.title: Bombay Hub: 7th Hack-Nation Global AI Hackathon

hacknova.title: HackNova

hackverse-19.title: Hackverse 19
hackverse-19.venue: Smt. Indira Gandhi College of Engineering
hackverse-19.desc: A space-technology hackathon with an online slide round followed by a 24-hour coding round at the college, with a prize pool of ₹35,000.

healthtech-founders-mixer.title: HealthTech Founder's Mixer (Mumbai)
healthtech-founders-mixer.desc: A small, screened evening for founders and senior operators of consumer businesses at MVP stage or beyond, especially in health, D2C and e-commerce.

ibm-think-mumbai.title: IBM Think Mumbai 2026
ibm-think-mumbai.desc: IBM's large one-day conference for business and technology leaders on scaling AI in enterprises, hybrid cloud and data sovereignty.

india-blockchain-week.title: India Blockchain Week 2026

media-accelerator-cohort.title: Media Accelerator & Startup Cohort

mobile-architecture-lab-4.priceNote: No ticket price shown · registration open

monad-blitz-mumbai.title: Monad Blitz Mumbai: Devcon Edition
monad-blitz-mumbai.timeNote: Times not shown on the page

mongodb-local-mumbai.title: MongoDB.local Mumbai

mumbai-meets-ai-06.title: Mumbai Meets AI 06: AI × Tech Builders Meetup
mumbai-meets-ai-06.venue: Exact venue emailed to selected attendees

swift-mumbai-assemble.title: Swift Mumbai Assemble!

titan-consumer-mixer.title: Titan Capital × V3 Ventures Consumer Mixer

unchained-summit-india.title: Unchained Summit India

we-founders-collab-oct10.title: Entrepreneurs Meetup by We Founders Collab
